errors.evidence: The description states that the Y-axis represents values in EUR, but the Y-axis itself has no label. This information is derived from the figure's caption, not from the visual elements of the axis.

The description groups the data points for 2014 and 2015 under a single approximate value ('around 21000'). In the figure, there is a visible, albeit small, increase between 2014 (approx. 20,800) and 2015 (approx. 21,200), which this generalization obscures.
